title: Operator exclusion list, per-tenant KMS quotas, and residency audit-proxy
author: Priya Menon
release_notes: Adds operator exclusion list to RBACv2, introduces per-tenant KMS usage quotas with throttling behavior and a signed audit-proxy for residency provenance. Backwards-compatible; opt-in via feature flag.
description: Context and motivation: We observed two recent incidents where long-lived operator credentials were used across multiple tenant scopes and a noisy customer caused KMS usage spikes that interfered with multi-tenant key throttles in some regions. This PR implements three coordinated safeguards: 1) an operator exclusion list enforced at RBACv2 decision time so flagged operator principals are denied sensitive KMS actions; 2) a per-tenant KMS usage quota enforcer that emits metrics and enforces soft throttles (with graceful degradation and a configurable backoff policy); and 3) a residency-audit-proxy that mirrors signed provenance envelopes to the compliance replay store so downstream auditors can verify region pinning decisions without exposing tenant secrets. High level changes (single continuous section): - RBAC: introduce OperatorExclusionRegistry and integrate into rbacv2 decision path. The registry is populated from operator onboarding and supports real-time updates via configmap and the operator-management API. - KMS quota: add a token-bucket backed quota enforcer on the KMS gateway with per-tenant keys and burst allowances; configurable thresholds include daily_quota, burst_tokens, and slow_start_fraction. Enforcement path returns a new error type KMSQuotaExceeded with a structured retry-after header. - Audit-proxy: new grpc/http sidecar service (audit/proxy) that receives signed audit envelopes, validates signature with customer CMK public material, normalizes residency assertions, and forwards a redacted envelope to the compliance store with provenance metadata. Service supports batching and backpressure to avoid coupling to the KMS path. - Observability: add metrics kms_quota_usage{tenant,region}, operator_excluded_decisions_total, audit_proxy_forwarded_envelopes_total, and a set of SLI-driven alerts. - Config: introduced feature flag security.operator_exclusion_enabled and kms.per_tenant_quota_enabled. Migration and rollout: operator exclusion defaults to OFF for 2 weeks to collect deny-rate telemetry, KMS quotas default to soft enforcement (metrics+logs) for 7 days then auto-enable hard throttling if no regressions are observed. Checklist: - [x] design doc (Linear ENG-2483 attached) - [x] unit tests for RBAC decision path - [x] integration tests for KMS quota on staging - [x] e2e happy-path through audit-proxy - [x] docs for operators/api and runbook for quota alerts - [x] feature flags and DB migration for operator registry - [x] performance benchmark (see comments) Commits (summary): - Add operator exclusion registry, API endpoints and ConfigMap watcher (rbac/*) - Integrate exclusion check into decision cache and policy compiler (rbac/compiler.go, rbac/decision.go) - Implement KMS quota enforcer and token-bucket backend (kms/quota/*) - Wire KMS gateway to quota enforcer and propagate structured errors (gateway/kms_handler.go) - Add audit-proxy service and client shim (audit/proxy/main.go, audit/proxy/client.go) - Add metrics, tracing spans, and alert rules (observability/*) - Tests: unit, integration, e2e harness updates (test/integration/kms_quota_test.go, test/e2e/audit_proxy_flow.test) Files changed (high level): - rbac/registry.go (new) - rbac/decision.go (modified) - rbac/compiler.go (modified) - gateway/kms_handler.go (modified) - kms/quota/enforcer.go (new) - audit/proxy/main.go (new) - audit/proxy/forwarder.go (new) - observability/metrics.yaml (modified) - test/integration/kms_quota_test.go (new) Small illustrative snippet (rbac decision integration): "if opRegistry.IsExcluded(principal) { log.Warnf(\"RBAC deny: excluded operator %s\", principal); return Decision{Allow:false, Reason:\"operator-excluded\"} }" Review conversation (thread as continuous chronology): Ava Chen: "Strong design; LGTM conceptually. Please add a test for operator exclusion update race (concurrent configmap updates + decision cache). Also document expected deny-rate metrics so SRE can baseline." Priya Menon (author): "Added operator_exclusion_race_test and documented metrics in observability/metrics.yaml; see commits c3f1a2. Race window is protected with a short read-write lock and decision cache invalidation on update." Diego Rivera: "Concern: KMS path is hot; adding quota checks could add latency. Can we make quick-path (cached token-bucket peek) inline and offload blocking token refills to a background worker? Also ensure quota check is O(1) and avoids allocation." Priya Menon: "Implemented a non-allocating fast-path peek and background refill worker; added microbenchmarks. P95 KMS gateway latency changed from 18ms to 20ms in our 1kQPS perf lab under normal load; added a feature flag to gate rollout." Liam O'Connor: "Audit-proxy looks good; please ensure signing verification failures are non-fatal for requests (we should forward with sanitization and an audit flag for manual inspection). Also add a replay-mode for backfilling existing envelopes." Priya Menon: "Audit-proxy now marks failures as 'provenance-warning' and forwards a redacted envelope; added replay-mode cli (audit/proxy/replay.go)." CI summary: - pre-commit lint: pass - go unit tests: initially failed (quota race), fixed in c3f1a2, now pass - integration tests (staging): pass - e2e tests: pass - security scan: pass Merge and rollout notes: Merged via squash on 2026-02-25 after final approval by Ava and Liam. Feature flags set to OFF and soft enforcement by default; we will enable observability windows and flip flags incrementally per-team. Runbook: included in docs/runbooks/security/operator-exclusion.md with steps to toggle flag, inspect metrics, and emergency disable. Follow-ups (future work): - Add per-operator policy exemptions for HA automation accounts with additional attestations (SEC-622) - Expose quota usage via billing API for chargeback - Add cross-region quota harmonization to avoid double-spend on global keys Related work: ENG-2483 (design), SEC-611 (post-incident action), SUP-927 (customer support ticket cited noisy tenant), ENG-3001 (follow-up performance optimization). Misc notes: This PR intentionally keeps the enforcement decision path centralized in RBACv2 so future policy overlays (canary rollouts, attribute-based exclusions) can reuse the same hook. Backwards compatibility: callers who previously relied on permissive operator principals will now see denies only after the feature flag is enabled.
